steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Refining means making specific, deliberate improvements — not just running the piece again but fixing identified problems.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Timing and pacing: the speed at which moments unfold — too fast loses impact, too slow loses engagement. Every pause must be earned.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Transitions: how you move between scenes — clumsy transitions break the theatrical experience. Make them part of the drama.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Consistency: every performance must be at the same level — energy, focus and delivery must be reliable and repeatable.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: What is the difference between rehearsing and refining? Why is refinement essential? | Describe how you would ensure smooth transitions between scenes in a devised piece. | How can pacing and timing affect the audience's experience of a key dramatic moment?

steps.body: Refinement is about SPECIFIC improvements — name what you changed and why Transitions should be DRAMATIC, not just functional In your portfolio, document refinement — show the journey from first draft to polished piece Technical elements must be integrated early, not bolted on
